- [ASSISTANT_SAID] One example of a scholarly article that shows evidence that gamification and interactivity can increase reading comprehension among children is "Game-based learning and student engagement: A study of the effect of Quizizz on student engagement and performance" by N.J. Draper, D.C. Brown, and D. Henderson published in the Journal of Learning Analytics in 2016.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The study found that the use of the game-based learning platform Quizizz led to higher student engagement and performance compared to traditional instruction methods.
